meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 启用后，Claude 会直接分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据文件，先探测内存再决定一次读入还是流式处理；回答会给出所需结论、行数和耗时，只在你要图或结果适合画图时才绘图。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析 CSV/Parquet/JSON 文件，执行分组、连接、聚合等操作，或处理时间序列、分布、绘图等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取 sales.parquet，按类别汇总销售额。
say.note: 它会按类别汇总销售数据并返回统计表。

say.text: 把时间列补全成连续小时，统计缺失值并画趋势图。
say.note: 它会先补全时间列，再生成趋势图。

say.text: 分析 users.csv 的重复行，给出清理后行数。
say.note: 它会检测重复行，并报告清理后的数量。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes CSV/Parquet/JSON files with DuckDB/Polars, probes memory to pick load vs stream, then returns answer with row counts and timing; charts only when wanted or needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze CSV/Parquet/JSON files, run group-by/join/aggregation operations, or handle time-series, distributions, plotting, etc.

say_en.text: Read sales.parquet and summarize sales by category.
say_en.note: It groups the data and returns a summary table.

say_en.text: Fill missing timestamps into an hourly series and plot the trend.
say_en.note: It completes the series first, then charts it.

say_en.text: Find duplicate rows in users.csv and report the cleaned row count.
say_en.note: It deduplicates and tells you the remaining row count.
